units.source_text: “原来如此……其实，我这头也无所谓……

en.t: I see... Actually, it makes no difference to me either...

units.source_text: 你们那头有这种打算，我可以奉陪打持久战的。

en.t: If that is what you people have in mind, I can go along with a war of endurance.

units.source_text: 一星期、十天、十五天，反正五十步笑百步，一回事……”

en.t: A week, ten days, fifteen days, in the end it is just the pot calling the kettle black, all the same thing..."
